sentence: This project runs a facility that measures lipids in tumor cells and tissues using mass spectrometry and imaging.
This project tries to understand how mutant mitochondrial genomes spread.
This project studies how changes in the non-coding genome, including super-enhancers, alter genes in diffuse large B cell lymphoma.
This project builds a method that stops specific synapses from forming between neurons to change how brain circuits connect in Drosophila.
This project looks at how high-throughput technologies that produce massive quantities of data are used in biomedical research.
This project provides laboratory support and testing for studies of ways to prevent HIV.
This project builds a map of how normal lungs and lungs with childhood interstitial lung disease develop, using stem cells and computational approaches.
This project brings together basic microscopy techniques with computational and three-dimensional imaging approaches for electron microscopy in biological research.
This project uses biostatistical methods to find genes and maternal lifestyle factors that influence the risk of congenital heart defects.
This project develops a treatment that uses gold nanomaterials and a near-infrared laser to break up kidney stones.
This project studies what causes sudden unexpected deaths in children, using genome sequencing and metabolomic techniques.
This project builds a computer system that detects in real time when healthcare workers are not using personal protective equipment.
This project studies how prenatal and adolescent alcohol exposure changes dopamine and glutamate in the anterior cingulate cortex of rats.
This project tries to find which bacterial genes drive intestinal inflammation by measuring the transcriptome of individual bacterial taxa.
This project uses a photon-counting mobile CT scanner and deep learning to improve the image quality of mobile CT.
This project builds a machine learning framework that combines home monitoring of vital signs and activity with acute care for patients discharged from the hospital.
This project tests deep learning models that use electronic health records to predict which patients with visual impairment receive low vision rehabilitation.
This project studies how glaucoma damages the retina and optic nerve in ways that do not depend on ocular pressure.
This project uses advanced imaging tools to see individual cells of the retinal vascular system and monitor the vascular health of the whole body.
This project develops quantitative magnetic resonance fingerprinting methods to detect and classify prostate cancer.
